BiblicalUsage: Maai was a priest and musician who walked in the procession at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them. His name stands among the brethren who sang as the wall was given back to God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Maai's place in the procession matters, because God is praised by named musicians, and the dedication was sung, not only built.
